responsibility: Declares shared utility state and helper routines for COBOL code generation. It exposes the global GCC tree decls representing runtime bookkeeping variables, flags controlling exception and DEPENDING ON behavior, and utility functions for numeric scaling, field access, refer offset/size calculation, exception recording, display helpers, array construction, and data-location computation that support many different parser_* lowerings.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declaration surface for shared code-generation utility globals and helpers; unlike genutil.cc, it introduces the extern runtime bookkeeping decls and helper prototypes without defining their behavior.
